description: A tenant of a Tributech Node, backed by exactly one enrollment group. Root of the tenant's site topology and the level all depth limits are counted from.

contents.name: Name
contents.description: Represents the name of the tenant. Matches the alias of the tenant's organization and the name of its enrollment group.
contents.comment: The enrollment group id itself is not repeated here - it is held in the twin metadata, which is the value the node stamps and the only one that can be trusted.

contents.name: DisplayNames
contents.description: Labels shown for this tenant, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of this tenant, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: DefaultLocale
contents.description: BCP-47 language tag of the entry in DisplayNames and Descriptions to fall back to when the requested locale is absent.

contents.name: Agents
contents.description: Agents assigned directly to the tenant, without a site.
